**What problem would this solve, or what would it let you do?**
Describe the use case, not just the feature - it helps to know the "why."

**What did you have in mind?**
A rough idea of how it might work is welcome, but not required.

**Anything else?**
Links, references to how other apps handle something similar, etc.
